description: Permanently delete a Jira issue by key. Destructive write action taking an EXPLICIT target — the issue key is required and there is no bulk form.
embedding_description: Permanently delete exactly one Jira issue by its required key, including the ticket's comments and attachments. This irreversible destructive write has a single-record target. Use it when the Jira record itself must be erased from the site.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Confirmation the issue was permanently deleted.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Be explicit that the named issue was permanently deleted and that this cannot be undone. State the exact key that was removed.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Permanently delete a Jira issue by key.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: jira.not_found: no issue with that key exists (it may already be deleted). jira.permission_denied: the service account lacks delete permission for this project. jira.invalid_params: the key was missing or empty.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: jira.not_found: confirm the key; the issue may already be gone. jira.permission_denied: deletion often needs an elevated project role — grant it or ask an admin. jira.invalid_params: supply the exact issue key.
